import ast, hashlib, json, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from devtools.core.paths import resolve_path
from devtools.core.time import Timestamp
from devtools.context.repository.identity import Repository, RepositoryId
from devtools.context.repository.observation import observe_repository_resources
from devtools.context.repository.resource import RepositoryResourceAddress
from devtools.context.python.modules.interpretation import PythonModuleRoot, interpret_python_module_resources, define_python_module_interpretation_universe
from devtools.context.python.modules.declarations import lookup_python_module_declaration
from devtools.context.python.classes.declarations import analyze_python_class_method_resources
from devtools.context.python.classes.bases import derive_python_direct_bases
from devtools.context.python.references.declarations.analysis import derive_python_declaration_references

RECIPES={
 'control': '',
 'assignment': 'f = 0\n',
 'match_capture': 'match 0:\n    case f:\n        pass\n',
 'match_star': 'match []:\n    case [*f]:\n        pass\n',
 'match_mapping': 'match {}:\n    case {**f}:\n        pass\n',
 'exception_alias': 'try:\n    raise ValueError()\nexcept ValueError as f:\n    pass\n',
}
results=[]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='devtools-ri-assurance-') as folder:
 root=Path(folder)
 for name, tail in RECIPES.items():
  for declaration in ('function','class'):
   head='def f():\n    pass\n' if declaration=='function' else 'class f:\n    pass\n'
   source=head+tail+'f()\n'
   if declaration=='class': source+='class LocalChild(f):\n    pass\n'
   sources={'target.py': source, 'consumer.py': 'from target import f\nf()\n'}
   if declaration=='class': sources['consumer.py']='from target import f\nclass Child(f):\n    pass\n'
   for path,text in sources.items(): (root/path).write_bytes(text.encode())
   addresses=tuple(RepositoryResourceAddress(p) for p in sources)
   snapshot=observe_repository_resources(repository=Repository(RepositoryId.parse('00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000099')),root=resolve_path(root),addresses=addresses,maximum_resource_bytes=4096)
   interpreted=interpret_python_module_resources(snapshot,module_root=PythonModuleRoot('.'),resource_addresses=addresses)
   universe=define_python_module_interpretation_universe(repository_id=snapshot.repository_id,interpretations=interpreted.interpretations)
   target=next(i for i in interpreted.interpretations if i.resource.address.value=='target.py')
   lookup=lookup_python_module_declaration(snapshot,module=target,declared_name='f')
   refs=derive_python_declaration_references(snapshot,resource_address=addresses[0],module_universe=universe)
   last=next(a for a in refs.assessments if a.source_text=='f' and a.occurrence.source_range.start_line==len((head+tail+'f()\n').splitlines()))
   row=dict(case=name,declaration=declaration,sources=sources,snapshot=str(snapshot.id),lookup=lookup.outcome.value,reference=last.outcome.value,reference_positive=last.reference is not None,expect_positive=name=='control',non_name_binding_nodes=[type(n).__name__ for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(source)) if isinstance(n,(ast.MatchAs,ast.MatchStar,ast.MatchMapping,ast.ExceptHandler))])
   consumer_refs=derive_python_declaration_references(snapshot,resource_address=addresses[1],module_universe=universe)
   row['consumer_reference_assessments']=[dict(source=a.source_text,outcome=a.outcome.value,positive=a.reference is not None) for a in consumer_refs.assessments if a.source_text=='f']
   if declaration=='class':
    agg=analyze_python_class_method_resources(snapshot,resource_addresses=addresses)
    bases=derive_python_direct_bases(snapshot,aggregate=agg,module_universe=universe)
    row['direct_bases']={a.child.declared_name:a.outcome.value for a in bases.assessments}
   results.append(row)
assert all(r['lookup']=='resolved' and r['reference_positive'] for r in results if r['case'] in {'control','match_capture','match_star','match_mapping','exception_alias'})
assert all(r['lookup']!='resolved' and not r['reference_positive'] for r in results if r['case']=='assignment')
out=dict(at=str(Timestamp.now()),baseline='5f53f5ac34b1a8a91e3119aa5faba329b8dedfa4',method='Independently authored real UTF-8 files; observation, native interpretation, declaration lookup, References and direct bases. Input code parsed only, never executed. No model or experiment run.',results=results)
Path(__file__).with_name('probes.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
